RootTable.Filter: SELECT DISTINCT o2.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, o2.object_type AS CLASSTYPE, o2.name AS type_name FROM ((t_attribute a INNER JOIN t_object o ON a.object_id = o.object_id) INNER JOIN t_object o2 ON a.classifier = o2.object_id) INNER JOIN t_package p ON p.package_id = o.package_id WHERE o.package_id IN (#Branch#) AND o2.package_id NOT IN (#Branch#) ORDER BY o2.name; #DB=COMMENT# Gives all the types that (1) are used for attributes and (2) that are not defined in the selected package or its subpackages. This query assumes that the attributes that have a type specified that is linked to an element (classifier) in the model, double-check with query attributes_with_type_without_classifier if needed. #DB=COMMENT#
